layout: app/modules/case_review/ — 8 registered function groups (cr_status, cr_share_initialized, cr_cases, cr_documents, cr_tag, cr_legend, cr_notes, cr_export). Page: GET /api/case-review/page renders pages/case_review.html — Document Center 3-pane pattern (documents+tags left, read-only viewer center, legend+evidence index+export right).

input_audit.note: Incident id — resolved against the tenant's own INCIDENT overlays; 404 if not theirs.
Vault document id; used as a pointer only — the module never writes to documents.
Enum: foundational | discovery | motion | evidence | misc (locked taxonomy, spec §2).
Enum: none | documentary | digital | physical | witness.
Legend entries [{label, color}] — per case, user-editable, purely visual.
[{document_id, vault_path?, name?, location?}] — one note can link several places across several documents.
Visual grouping label referencing a legend entry; no semantic meaning.
yellow_access cookie/session — all storage is in the tenant's own cloud vault.

preview_state: Document viewer embeds the existing read-only DC stream (/api/dc/document/{id}/view) — a byte stream for display only.
review_state: Notes and legend are listed for review before export; each is editable/deletable by the tenant.
output_how: EVIDENCE_INDEX overlays written via UnifiedOverlayManager into the tenant's own OAuth-connected cloud vault (anchor document_id='evidence-index:{case_id}', vault_path=VAULT_CASE_REVIEW_FILE). Export returns plain text.
output_where: Tenant's cloud vault — Semptify servers hold no documents and no index state.
output_why: Per-case evidence index for attorney/legal-reviewer sessions; survives reload because it lives in the tenant's vault.
process_description: Tenant marks legal_share_initialized (self-declared — actual sharing happens outside Semptify) → module unlocks. Tenant tags vault documents into the locked category/evidence_type taxonomy (metadata only — cloud folders are never restructured), edits the case color legend, and writes evidence notes that link multiple document locations. Export produces a paste-ready plain-text index.
process_context: Productionization of the case-review-tool.html stopgap per the locked build spec. No attorney/Legal-role vault access is built — tenant-side sharing only (Decision 1).
invariants: No write/edit path to original documents exists anywhere in this module — viewer is read-only, tag overlay stores only a document_id pointer.
certified is hardcoded False on every overlay this module creates — only Vault Services certifies, and only original documents.
Evidence Index is per-case, not vault-wide.
Color carries no semantic meaning — it only matches a highlight to its legend label.
Module locked until the tenant self-marks legal_share_initialized.
